row.name: Kaigrad
row.detailed_description: What if there was no Sun? If you had to fight not only with others, but with the universe itself for the crumbs of light? The darkness is near. In such circumstances, a person's values are overturned. People stop being people. There was only a slim chance to fix it. But the path is thorny. And only you can choose the road! 'Kaigrad' is a non-linear visual novel in the genre of dark fantasy. The action takes place in the world of 'Kaigrad', where Light comes only from people, animals and all living things. He is on the verge of total darkness. People are distraught and seize every opportunity to prolong their miserable existence, forgetting about principles and morals. You have to find out what happened here, who is to blame for this and try to fix it! At the moment, the game has three main branches of passage, each of which has several endings. We are planning at least two more DLCs, which will have no less variability than the main part of the game. A story that will stay in your memory for a long time The oppressive atmosphere of a dying world Non-linearity is not in words, but in deeds Characters you don't want to end a conversation with A love line that leaves a pleasant aftertaste Great soundtracks As well as unanswered questions and... answers without questions.
row.short_description: Kaigrad - is a non-linear visual novel in the genre of dark fantasy. The action takes place in a world where Light comes only from people, animals and all living things. The darkness is near. You have to find out what happened here, who is to blame for this and try to fix it!
row.notes: Kaigrad contains physical abuse, blood, drug abuse, self-harm, as well as nudity, sexual materials, and a bit of torture.

row.name: Sixth Extinction
row.detailed_description: One of the most original games Sixth Extinction is not your average puzzle game. With a dark and hard-hitting story lurking beneath the gameplay, it's up to you to uncover the truth and play your way to an important revelation about both yourself and the world you live in. Discover your true nature: learn what your choice say about you, and open your mind to a positive change. Think outside the box: use your intellect to conquer the obstacles in your way, and discover the game's deep message. Short but thought-provoking: immerse yourself in an hour-long, atmospheric experience. Made with love: from the hand-drawn visuals to the poetic narration, every moment has been crafted to enhance your enjoyment. A dark message: the story of this game contains heavy themes of extinction, revenge and violence. An adult audience is recommended.
row.short_description: Sixth extinction is a dark, narrative-driven experience about extinction and discovering the true nature of yourself. Can you outwit the obstacles in your way, uncover the truth and begin a change?
row.reviews: “I was captivated throughout, but even when all is said and done, Sixth Extinction’s narrative continues to amaze.” 9 out of 10 – The Game Crater “This adventurous game is worth every dime of your money.” 10 out of 10 – AlphaDigits “For what the game is priced at, you get a good hour of puzzles and an excellent narrative story with a powerful ending.” 8,5 out of 10 – Games Hedge
row.notes: Can include include violence and blood.

row.name: Paper Glider
row.detailed_description: Paper Glider is a construction-paper-styled game in which you control a gliding paper triangle through a series of 70 colorful levels. The controls are simple but difficult to master, leading to a challenging and rewarding gameplay experience. Learn to master your momentum to complete all 7 worlds! The goal is simple: reach the end of each level. As you progress through Paper Glider's 7 worlds, this task becomes increasingly difficult. From avoiding objects with gravitational pulls and dodging past projectiles, to teleporting around levels and cloning yourself, there are many different challenges and features to discover on your journey to complete each world! Along with 70 unique levels to play through, you are also able to view various stats about your gameplay. Find out how many times you have died on each level and how long it took you to beat them. Track your fastest times or your slowest, and which levels you have died on the most. There are all kinds of statistics to see!

row.name: 修真之路
row.detailed_description: 仙人抚我顶,结发受长生,此去别凡罹，逍遥自在身。《修真之路》是一款文字修真放置类游戏，我们致力于打造一个围绕“功法”为主题，内涵丰富的修仙世界。玩家将扮演资质平平的凡人，偶得机缘踏上了修真之路，拜入仙门，打造法器，修炼功法，收养灵宠，建设洞府，收集天材地宝，克服路上的种种凶险和苦难，在九死一生的天地磨砺中勇夺长生。 游戏特色： 1、炼体修法，大道殊途问乾坤 两大方向，自由修炼，没有等级，只论境界，实力成长肉眼可见 2、洞天福地，两仪四象生八卦 洞天福地，五行灵根，天材地宝，应有尽有，有大能者方可居之 3、炼药锻器，仙丹灵宝助飞升 丹药装备，自行打造，坊市交易，易容挑事，还原真实修仙体验 4、法宝功法，组合搭配显策略 功法秘籍，丰富多样，法宝神兵，作用万千，任君选择自由搭配 5、奇遇机缘，仙路漫漫觅长生 风流轶事，高人指点，古修传承，秘境大阵，没有奇遇何谈修仙

row.name: Curatours
row.detailed_description: Welcome to Curatours! Curatours is a social tour platform for culture and heritage. Visit incredible places filled with art, artefacts, stories and friends. Visitors can access tours of museums around the world from desktop, phones or VR headsets. In VR it's an incredibly immersive experience and on other devices it feels like a cross between a video call and playing a multiplayer game. Curatours is free to download and offers three types of cultural tour: Self-Guided Start a solo tour and explore the experiences at your own pace with this self-guided option. Private Tour Start or join a private online tour, using a private room code to keep you in control of who can join your tour group. Public Tour Jump in to an online public tour to share and explore together with other members of the public. Virtual Spaces for Culture, Museums and Galleries Curatours offers visitors a wide range of interactive experiences, from local museums to cultural and historic exhibitions. The virtual spaces allow visitors to get up close and personal with animals, artworks, and artefacts in ways not possible in the real world, all from the comfort of their own homes! Download Curatours for free today and experience: Bradford District Museum and Galleries The Bradford District is home to some of the most exciting museums and galleries in the UK. We are thrilled to host a pilot exhibit, leading to a programme of work celebrating Bradford as the 2025 City of Culture 2025. Uncover strange stone markings amongst the ancient neolithic moors Get up close and personal with a historic haunted night in Bolling Hall Explore the Belle Vue photography studio, where local Bradford people were immortalised in film between 1902 and 1975 Museum of Colour Too often we ignore the many achievements of the generations that came before us. The ‘Respect Due’ project aims to capture as many of these unique perspectives as possible, showcasing a selection of individuals through art, audio interviews and personal artefacts. Curatours is proud to offer a permanent virtual home for the exhibit, and showcase an exciting step for the Museum of Colour in their mission to open up new avenues for accessibility, inclusivity, and the preservation of cultural heritage in an increasingly digital world. Museum of Plastic 2121 Visit a future where single use plastics are only ever found in museums. Museum of Plastic 2121 is an imagined future museum, built to teach future generations about plastics and tell the story of how activism started in 2021 led to the positive change that resulted in us cleaning up our oceans and forever changing our relationship with plastic. Taking inspiration from the Solarpunk movement, Curatours worked closely with South African activists Greenpop and Baz-Art , utlising some of their real world murals and 3D paintings. Built 100 years from now in an imagined future where things have worked out well for both the planet and humanity, the exhibit is perfectly at home on the Curatours platform which isn’t constrained by time or space. and more!
row.short_description: Curatours provides up close, personal access to cultural exhibitions within the safety and convenience of your own virtual space. Designed from the ground up to be as accessible to as many audiences as possible, unlocking real-world content that may have previously been out of reach.

row.name: Veneficium
row.detailed_description: Being on your guard will become second nature in Veneficium, a survival-horror game developed by a passionate team. Play as Abigail Vandran, a witch who has only one goal in mind: to find her grandmother Willow and escape a forest of death... Only if she survives the wrath of the demons lurking in the mist. ⛧ 𝘐𝘮𝘮𝘦𝘳𝘴𝘪𝘷𝘦 𝘌𝘹𝘱𝘦𝘳𝘪𝘦𝘯𝘤𝘦: Explore a realistic environment set deep in the woods, filled with hair-raising sounds that are sure to hold you spellbound. ⛧ 𝘚𝘵𝘦𝘢𝘭𝘵𝘩: Be careful where you step and use your environment to your advantage in escaping unpredictable enemies, or it may cost you your life. ⛧ 𝘎𝘭𝘰𝘰𝘮𝘺 𝘈𝘵𝘮𝘰𝘴𝘱𝘩𝘦𝘳𝘦: Find your way in foggy surroundings strewed with trees and mysterious locations, with your lantern as your only light. Step upon traces of dark and wicked practices that will chill you to the bone. ⛧ 𝘚𝘱𝘦𝘭𝘭𝘤𝘢𝘴𝘵𝘪𝘯𝘨: Gather ingredients and create spells from your book of shadows that will help you escape your enemy's notice.
row.short_description: 𝘚𝘵𝘢𝘺 𝘲𝘶𝘪𝘦𝘵. 𝘚𝘵𝘢𝘺 𝘩𝘪𝘥𝘥𝘦𝘯. 𝘞𝘢𝘵𝘤𝘩 𝘺𝘰𝘶𝘳 𝘴𝘵𝘦𝘱𝘴. 𝘐𝘧 𝘺𝘰𝘶 𝘥𝘰𝘯'𝘵, 𝘙𝘶𝘯. Play as Abigail in her quest to find her grandmother in a cursed forest. Use your spellcasting abilities to hide from various dangers. Will you survive the night?
row.notes: Veneficium features graphic gore content, death and strong language.

row.name: Evo\Wave
row.detailed_description: Evo\Wave is a 3D platformer featuring the little AI named LAI-6 who learns new programs and skills to restore the world! Travel through levels inspired by the different graphical eras of the video game, repair the Evo\Core and gain new skills to fight the evil MagnaVex! A 3D Collectathon evolving through different periods of video game history! The more you progress through the game while repairing the Evo\Core. The more you will experience wildly different graphics styles from the history of video games! A retro OutRun graphic style inspired by the '80s with Synthwave music reminiscent of Miami 80! A bold yet limited color palette permeates the landscape, purple skies and teal vegetation are the norm in this virtual world. Awesome music will follow you wherever you go, making you feel like you’re cruising through the neon sunset. Unlock skills like double jumping and the power of gliding through the air that will allow you to navigate through the levels and move around in new and fun ways! Collect as many collectibles as you can, from Evo\Core peripherals and Components or Facts Sheets that will give you historical anecdotes about video games! Watch out for glitches and corrupted enemies that MagnaVex will send to counter your progress! Evo\Wave is a game designed to be accessible to all age groups, both young and old, and aims to bring some LGBTQ+ representation with LAI-6, our young non-binary artificial intelligence. In addition, a lot of attention has been directed towards visual accessibility by reducing elements like flashing lights and low contrast that would prevent some people from enjoying Evo\Wave!
row.short_description: Evo\Wave is a 3D platformer featuring LAI-6, an A.I. with a goal to restore the world following the passage of MagnaVex who brought the world back to a retro era. Repair the Evo\Core to progress through the different graphic periods of the video game history!

row.name: The 2020 Trail
row.detailed_description: 2020 will go down in history as one of the most disastrous years ever. Everyone alive felt the effects of the events — whether it was discrimination, politics, Mother Nature or the pandemic. To keep our heads up at Games with Geebs, we felt there was no better way to get through the chaotic times than to laugh at them. That's where The 2020 Trail comes in. “[Humor] offers a way of being sane in an insane place.” — Thomas Kuhlman Take a trip down memory lane in this Oregon Trail parody game where you traverse through the calendar year of 2020. Your decisions directly affect your mood and can make you more susceptible to catching the ‘rona. Don’t forget to stock up on toilet paper! Make decisions on how you spend the year Cook, dance, or skate to boost your mood and fend off depression Avoid catching the 'rona! Plow through pesky shoppers with carts Customize your character and time travel in style! Revisit the good, the bad, and the straight-up ridiculous events of 2020 Be THAT guy that stocks up on TP
row.short_description: The 2020 Trail is an Oregon Trail parody game which takes you on a trip through the chaotic year of 2020. Keep your resources stocked, your mood high, and make the right decisions to avoid catching the 'rona.

row.name: Over The Phone
row.detailed_description: Over The Phone is a talking sim about a photographer named Jake who meets a girl in the unlikeliest of places, on a customer support call with his internet service provider. The game is akin to a visual novel, in that it's primarily reading / listening to the conversation and periodically making choices about what to say. Short game: ~25-30 min playthrough 2.5 endings (2 primary endings, with one having an additional choice at the end) Chill original soundtrack Harper voiced by Catsen (ttv/catsen) Choices Most choices are part of a tone system, which include a word below that describes the tone/intention of that line. Making choices of a particular type makes it more likely to have similar choices later on and fewer choices that conflict with that tone. If you played Drinks With Abbey, you're probably familiar with how unforgiving the game is when it comes to choices. You needed to pick specific ones throughout to get the 'best' ending. In OTP, that's not the case. The types of choices you make do decide which ending you get, as well as change the conversation and future choices. But it's more flexible in terms of which specific options are chosen.
row.short_description: A short talking sim with choices. Get to know Harper over a handful of voice-acted calls and text chats.

row.name: Atrius Star
row.detailed_description: Atrius Star is a bullet hell roguelite with challenging AI, fun weapons, monster infighting, and speed running. Fly in on your helicopter, fight the monsters, and save the princess of Atrius from the evil scientist Dral. Challenging AI The monsters in Atrius Star are built upon a concept called 'orthogonal unit differentiation'. This means each unit operates in a unique way causing you to make meaningful decisions to defeat each one. Fun Weapons The weapons in Atrius Star include a chainsaw, rifle, shotgun, SMG, rocket launcher, and grenade launcher. Each weapon has its own strength, weakness, and cool down mechanic causing you to regularly switch between weapons to survive. Monster Infighting If enough chaos ensues or monsters are manipulated just right, they will start to fight each other. It's a truly satisfying event that creates laughs and saves you ammo. Speed Running With each game timed, you can get endless replayability by trying to beat your all-time best.
row.short_description: Bullet hell roguelite with challenging AI, fun weapons, monster infighting, and speed running.

row.name: 轮回修真OL
row.detailed_description: 轮回修真OL是一款真正的在线沙盒世界游戏，修真不再是玩单机，实时交互，组队闯荡。这是一个自由的，也是一个凶险的修真世界。 担心刷的东西没有价值？氪金才给东西？这里的坊市可以自由交易绝大部分修真资源。 是想要修炼，还是猎杀妖兽，炼器，炼药，制符，或者是采集修真所需的各种资源都没问题。 想要培养灵兽？虽然上古血脉已经稀薄，但是灵兽通过不断的吞噬进化，可以进阶成更高级的存在！ 甚至你可以改变这个修真界。布下聚灵法阵，提高灵气浓度，拒绝末法时代。
row.short_description: 这是一款真正的多人在线沙盒修真世界。如果你已经对枯燥无味的挂机修真感觉到疲惫，这款游戏会适合你。 炼丹炼器符阵，灵兽培育，你甚至可以布阵改变灵气浓度，而其他人也会受益。

row.name: Play The Fox
row.detailed_description: ◆ Rules The game moves in two phases, 'morning' and 'night'. ◆ Morning Approach a spirit and tap the button! Activate a skill! But you have to get there first! Beat your opponent! You win when your opponent's HP is down to zero! ◆ Night Night is time for truce. Skills cannot be activated. Instead, you can summon spirits to where you want! Build your strategy, thinking carefully about your moves the next morning! ◆ Characters Skills change depending on your combination of animal and spirit! Snakes turn invisible, boars charge forwards, and roosters move in every direction! Choose your favorite animal and get ready for battle! Don’t just choose your Chinese horoscope – everyone will know how old you are! ◆ Play with friends It's great fun! Team up with a friend and fight for a win! (Maximum 2 players per team)
row.short_description: Chinese horoscope online battle 'Play The Fox' released!

row.name: ZombiesWaves
row.detailed_description: Twitter : Welcome to ZombiesWaves :) The game : - You must go and rescue your friend who is stuck behind a door. For that you must open all the doors of the game to go and rescue her, but beware of the waves of zombies that will prevent you from going to help your friend. Weapons : - As soon as you eliminate zombies, you will earn money which will allow you to have better weapons, but also advantages (such as for example, the fast reload). Mystery boxes : - In the game map, you will find mystery boxes which will allow you to have weapons, grenades and mines to help you eliminate the zombies. Zombies hide powers : - When you go to eliminate zombies, some of them will drop powers (like for example 'Easy elimination', this power allows to eliminate a lot of zombies in 1 second). WARNING We decided to make the character controls quite difficult. As soon as you start playing it will be hard but as you go it will be much easier :) Thank you for your understanding So ? Ready for the adventure?
row.short_description: Your friend is blocked! Eliminate the zombies - Open all the doors - Help your friend.

row.name: The Sound of Fireworks: The Haiku
row.detailed_description: Hey new journal, My old journal ran out of pages, so you're holding the fort now. Let me introduce myself! My name is Amimi Imai, I'm 18, and most of my friends call me 'Hanabi'. Why? Well, I'm a big fan of fireworks! My mom loved them, and the way she always talked about them made me want to see them for myself. But you know, life happens, and I haven't had the chance to see them in person. Well...not yet at least, but we'll get to that. This year has been a doozy: I had to move to a new city for family reasons, had to leave my friends behind, and we could only communicate through our phones. Major bummer. But I had a new school and new experiences to look forward to! I had big plans to do my best and get into the best university so I could follow my dreams of being a writer. But school can be like life sometimes: hard, cruel, and unwelcoming. I knew if I just put my head down, I would get through it somehow. But that all changed, when a certain dumb, uncoordinated, but amazing guy found his way to me. Him and his haikus. You'll get what I mean. Well, I gotta run, but I'll talk to you soon! Bye-bye! -Amimi~ The Sound of Fireworks: The Haiku is the first part of a (hopeful) trilogy following the friendships, hardships, and path of Amimi, an 18 year old student who's recent move from home has left her succumbed to a new high school and new life without the friends she's had by her side. But as a few weeks pass by, Amimi gets to know Uta, another student recently transferred living the same issues that Amimi is going through. While the chemistry is, well, off to say the least, a budding friendship is soon to be made, and Amimi's high school life will change: like the night sky from the bang of a Firework. > Part 1 of The Sound of Fireworks Trilogy, TSOF: The Haiku is a single path/ending visual novel about love, acceptance, and a good ol' awkward budding teenage friendship. Length: ~40,000 words VOICE ACTORS: Amimi - Hesketts / @thehesketts Uta - Pascal Casimier / @pcasi_va Hina - Hannah Dove / @HannahDoveVA Aiko - Heidi Tabing / @HeidiTabing Kenta - Drew Kocour / @dregtheotaku Takumi - Nick Chang / @CloverHouraisan Zuki - Ken Hoang Vo / @Komi_Ken_Art
row.short_description: Follow the story of Amimi Imai, an 18 year old student who's recent move from home has left her succumbed to a new high school and new life. The Sound of Fireworks: The Haiku is a single path/ending visual novel about love, acceptance, and a good ol' awkward budding teenage friendship.
row.reviews: “The Sound of Fireworks: The Haiku is an adorable story of overcoming trauma and sometimes going over your limit if you want to succeed. Down the line, it made me root heavily for our heroine to succeed even with her difficult obstacles. It possesses an extremely relatable story with a fine handful of characters and cute art.” 7/10 – Far2close - VN Plays! “What it blows in full VN functionality, it more than compensates with its heart-winning sound & poetically real expression of puppy-platonic love!” Recommended – DaRevieweD

row.name: VR Guardians
row.detailed_description: Enter the worlds of VR Guardians, where you find yourself in the belly of the beasts and awaken the colossal creatures that reside within its stages. Choose between the scorching embers of the Lava World, surrounded by flowing magma and the skeletal remains of the fallen as you fight the sleeping Fire Guardian; or dive into the depths of the Underwater World, in the middle of a sunken castle ruins as you try to avoid being the Water Guardian's next prey. VR Guardians utilizes the Oculus headset’s default control scheme along with graphical in-game instructions – allowing the users to immerse themselves into the worlds intuitively and seamlessly. Solely designed for a 360 degree view, players can delve into the intricately designed stages without a need for a lot of space as the game can be fully experienced even when sitting or standing-in-place.
row.short_description: Wield your weapons and face the wrath of colossal creatures. Fight your way through a barrage of projectiles, fireballs and gargantuan teeth and claws as you stumble into the terrifying stages where the VR Guardians dwell. Are you up for the challenge?
